bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'STORAGE_MOUNT='; findmnt -T /mnt/g -no TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE
printf 'STORAGE_EXISTS='; test -d /mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos && echo YES
printf 'USERBOT='; systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service
printf 'UNAUTHORIZED_WORKERS\n'; for unit in gace-public-video-all-joined-retry-20261114.service gace-public-video-all-joined-20261114.service; do echo "$unit=$(systemctl --user show "$unit" -p ActiveState --value 2>/dev/null || echo not_loaded)";done
printf 'SINGLE_WORKERS\n'; for unit in gace-public-video-only-nippon-20261114.service gace-public-video-collect-retry-20261114.service; do echo "$unit=$(systemctl --user show "$unit" -p ActiveState --value 2>/dev/null || echo not_loaded)";done
printf 'TARGET_FILES\n';find /mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos/1877875443 -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f %s bytes\n' | sort | tail -30
printf 'TARGET_LEDGER\n'; if test -f /mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos/_jobs/thegreatolddaysofnippongv.json;then cat /mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos/_jobs/thegreatolddaysofnippongv.json;else echo NO_LEDGER;fi
printf '\nSOURCE_FLAGS\n';python3 scripts/userbot_public_video_archive.py --help | head -18
printf 'RESIDENT_HEALTH\n';python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py health
